subject: Discovery recap: Data privacy & logging requirements
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finserv-analytics.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: Data privacy & logging requirements

Hi Samir — great to meet today, and thanks for walking us through FinServ Analytics' use cases. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook.

Pain points you shared:
- PII leakage risk from LLM prompts & responses (customer names, account numbers, SSNs)
- Need to redact sensitive tokens before persisting logs and analytics
- Auditability: they need immutable, queryable audit logs with per-request metadata and retention controls
- Regulatory requirement: 90-day retention for identifiable content; longer for anonymized telemetry

Current stack and constraints:
- Backend on AWS (EKS + S3), identity via Okta, KMS-managed keys via AWS KMS
- In-house preprocessing pipeline that strips certain fields today; want model-level guarantees
- Security/Legal must review SOC 2 Type II evidence and security questionnaire before a POC

Success criteria you listed:
1) PII redaction before writing logs to S3 (or never persisting raw prompts)
2) Configurable retention policy per tenant (90 days for PII)
3) Audit logs with request timestamp, model version, route, and redaction status
4) Support for customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private or Dedicated deployment
5) Low-latency inference that meets your SLA (p50 < 250ms for 512-token requests)

What Redwood can offer (high level):
- Redaction support at request time: configurable filters and post-processing hooks that redact tokens before logs are written
- Configurable retention policies and an immutable audit trail; logs can be exported to your S3 or retained in our secure telemetry store per contract
- Private/Dedicated deployment options that allow integration with customer KMS for key ownership
- SOC 2 Type II report and security questionnaire (attached) + offer to schedule a technical security call with one of our infra engineers

Next steps:
1) I attached our standard security questionnaire (security-questionnaire.xlsx) — please fill and return; we can pre-populate some answers if you prefer.
2) We'll send SOC 2 Type II evidence after NDA/LOI step — happy to gate it behind an MSA if required.
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive with Avery (serving runtime lead) and your infra/security folks — suggested times below.
4) Identify a short PoC: 2-week sandbox with 1-2 routes, focused on redaction + audit logs.

Proposed meeting slots (PDT): Tue 6/16 10:00-11:00, Wed 6/17 14:00-15:00. Let us know what works.

Thanks again — we'll wait for the completed questionnaire and a preferred slot.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: security-questionnaire.xlsx; redwood-product-sheet.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finserv-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finserv-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Data privacy & logging requirements

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap and good list. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: our legal expects a 90-day retention period for any identifiable PII. Telemetry/anonymized metrics can be kept for 18 months. Any logging path that contains raw prompt/response must be subject to the 90-day rule.

2) Redaction: goal is to have redaction performed before any data leaves our VPC. We currently do a first-pass scrub but we want a guarantee that any persisted logs are redacted or tokenized. Is redaction pipeline configurable to our regex rules and custom entity lists?

3) Key management: we need the option for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) and ideally an HSM-backed option for the Private deployment.

4) SOC2: please send SOC 2 Type II evidence and any penetration test summary. Legal will also want the filled security questionnaire back (I attached our copy with a few internal comments).

We'd like to move to a short security call with your infra engineer. Wed 6/17 14:00-15:00 PDT works for us. 

FYI attaching the questionnaire with comments.

Best,
Samir
Head of Infra & Security
FinServ Analytics
samir.patel@finserv-analytics.com

Attachment: security-questionnaire-filled.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finserv-analytics.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Data privacy & logging requirements

Samir — appreciate the quick turnaround and the commented questionnaire. Answers to your numbered items below: 

1) Retention: Yes — we support configurable retention windows per tenant/route. For hosted customers we can enforce 90-day retention for any record marked as PII; for Dedicated/Private customers you can choose to store logs only in your S3 with lifecycle policies you control.

2) Redaction: Our runtime supports pre-persist redaction hooks. These are configurable with regex and custom entity lists, and we can add a post-processing verification step that computes a redaction hash so you can prove the original content was redacted. For your use case we recommend an in-VPC Private deployment so the redaction happens inside your network boundary.

3) KMS/HSM: Supported — customer-managed KMS is available and we've done HSM-backed key integrations for a few finance customers. We'll document options and required network configuration in the security call.

4) SOC2 & pentest: attaching links to our SOC 2 Type II report and a pentest summary in the shared doc link. We can provide the formal reports behind an NDA or MSA.

Next steps (updated):
- Wed 6/17 14:00 PDT: technical security call (Avery + Neha + your infra/legal). I'll send a calendar invite.
- I'll pre-fill the questionnaire with technical answers where possible and return it to you by EOD tomorrow.
- Post-call: propose a 2-week sandbox PoC with Private deployment scoped around redaction + audit log verification.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/finserv-analytics
Discovery deck (read-only): https://redwood.ai/share/discovery-deck-RDW-2026-4589

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

- Marissa
